newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Airlines lowers some fares.
newsitem.headline: Southwest Airlines lowers some fares.

text.p: Southwest Airlines Co said on Friday that it has reduced the seven-day advance purchase fare on many of its flights for travel from December 3, 1996 through April 4, 1997.
The fares will be available from Salt Lake City and the Texas cities of Austin, San Antonio and Houston to several destinations on the West Coast, the carrier said.
Tickets must be purchased within one day of making a reservation, at least seven days before departure, Southwest said. All tickets must be purchased by December 31, 1996, Southwest said.
The amounts of the discount vary city by city. A trip between Salt Lake City and Reno is $29 each way under this program compared with a full fare of $80 one way, a company spokeswoman said.
